subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should the shared model-facing `write` tool permanently gain the opt-in `append: true` parameter once the backend, cancellation, catalog, and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: This creates a durable agent-tool capability rather than repairing an existing input contract, so a technically correct implementation still requires product and API ownership intent.

options.title: Accept opt-in append
options.body: Keep overwrite as the default and land append after every backend has equivalent semantics, focused coverage, and exact-head real proof.

options.title: Keep write overwrite-only
options.body: Reject this parameter and address append workflows through a separate owner-approved primitive or workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in append
recommendation.body: Keep overwrite as the default and land append after every backend has equivalent semantics, focused coverage, and exact-head real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history across the agent write implementation and hardened sandbox filesystem boundary where the permanent contract must live.
